correctness.rationale: All 131071 subsets were exhaustively checked against induced maximum degree <=1; 867 faces; 423 matched pairs and all 867 nodes acyclic; critical CW cells one vertex, one two-cell, 19 three-cells. Signed exact gradient recurrences yield boundary coefficients gcd1; independent integral column elimination agrees. Primitive three-cell attaching map cancels the only two-cell, leaving 18 three-spheres. Full exact signed fixed-face Lefschetz checks over all 136 affine maps give the stated character and no invariants. Standalone packaged scripts and their execution outputs reproduce each computation. This is a finite theorem and not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The 17-vertex Paley graph is a canonical self-complementary strongly regular graph, and cutoff-two higher independence is a natural topology motivated by the cited primary literature. The new integral homotopy classification, complete affine character, two-dimensional quarter-turn subrepresentation and rationally acyclic quotient provide structural information not implied by the known ordinary-independence or neighborhood-complex homotopy types. The finite exact invariant is mathematically motivated and reproducible; no artificial parameter slice or asserted infinite generalization.
